_note: Reference ranges used by the alert engine. For each vital: a value inside 'caution' is Normal; outside 'caution' but inside 'urgent' raises a Caution alert; outside 'urgent' raises an Urgent alert. Format is [low, high]; null means no limit on that side. These are prototype defaults and must be reviewed by qualified medical professionals before real use. Any key left out keeps the built-in default.

heartRate._source: Resting adult range 60-100 bpm (American Heart Association); lower edge relaxed to 50 for fit crew.

systolic._source: High from 140 (stage 2) and crisis above 180 (American Heart Association); low below 90 / 80 as a prototype assumption.

diastolic._source: High from 90 (stage 2) and crisis above 120 (American Heart Association); low below 60 / 50 as a prototype assumption.

sleepHours._source: Adults are advised 7+ hours (CDC / AASM); 6 hours used as the flag because crews often sleep less in orbit.

mood._source: Self-rated 1 (low) to 5 (high); a score below 3 is flagged. Not a clinical scale.
